title: Delete the authorization code of a TikTok post
content_data:
Use this endpoint to delete the authorization code of a TikTok post. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/post/authorize/delete/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required} | string | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041) to this field.| | item_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TikTok post.

To obtain the public posts of a TikTok account, use [/business/video/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228421622786).

Example: `7123456789123456789`.

Note: If the TikTok post doesn't have an authorization code, either because the code is not generated or is deleted, an error will occur. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/post/authorize/delete/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "business_id": "{{business_id}}", "item_id": "{{item_id}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| item_id | string | The ID of the TikTok post.

Example: `7123456789123456789`. | #| auth_code_status | string | The status of the authorization code.

Enum value:

  • `DELETED`: The authorization code has been deleted.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "auth_code_status": "DELETED", "item_id": "{{item_id}}" } } (/code) ```
